how.title: How It Works
how.sub: From search to collection in three steps.
how.step1_desc: Type an artist name. Underflow searches Bandcamp, Juno, Beatport, Decks.de, and Discogs simultaneously.
how.step2_desc: Listen to previews, compare results across platforms, and discover related artists you've never heard of.
how.step3_desc: Add tracks to your wishlist, tag them your way, and click through to purchase on any platform.

features.title: Everything you need in one place
features.sub: Built for DJs and record collectors who take their music seriously.
features.card1_desc: Type an artist name. Get digital and vinyl-only results from Bandcamp, Juno, Beatport, Decks.de, and Discogs — all at once. Find vinyl-only releases you'd never see on digital stores.
features.card2_desc: Our algorithm analyzes every track to map remixers, collaborators, and featured artists. Color-coded relation badges (R/F/C/O). Follow the chain — discover music you'd never find manually.
features.card3_desc: Preview tracks without leaving the app. Full transport controls, seek bar, volume. Floating mini-player stays on top while you work. Real-time spectrum analyzer.
features.card4_desc: Spot a track? Heart it. Ready to buy? Move to buy list. Purchased? It's in your collection. Every step tracked, nothing lost.
features.card5_desc: Create your own tag groups with colors. Organize by mood, tempo, key, genre — whatever fits your workflow. Filter by tags with AND/OR logic.
features.card6_desc: Your collection lives on your machine in a SQLite database. No cloud storage — your data stays local. Your data, your rules.

more.batch_desc: Search up to 10 artists at once

more.import_desc: Bulk import artists from text files

faq.title: Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know before downloading.
faq.a1: Underflow is free with limits. The free plan is enough to try the service and maintain a small collection. If you want to grow your collection seriously, upgrade your plan or purchase extra usage tokens. This model ensures fair usage and stable server performance for everyone.
faq.a2: No. Underflow is a search and discovery tool. The service does not store or distribute music. Audio previews are streamed directly from the platform servers (Bandcamp, Juno, Beatport, Decks.de, Discogs). When you find a track you want, you click through to purchase it on the respective platform.
faq.q3: How does smart artist discovery work?
faq.a3: Our algorithm analyzes track metadata to identify remixers, collaborators, and featured artists. You get a visual network of related artists with color-coded relation types: R (remixer), F (featuring), C (collaborator), O (original).
faq.a4: Bandcamp, Juno Records, Beatport, Decks.de, and Discogs. All five are searched simultaneously with unified results.
faq.a5: Locally on your machine in a SQLite database. Your tags, wishlists, and collection never leave your computer. Search requests go through our server for speed and platform compatibility.
faq.a6: Windows 10/11 (x64), macOS with Intel processors, and macOS with Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3).

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.p_general: These Terms govern your use of Underflow (the "Service") — a desktop application and the server infrastructure behind it. By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service. Questions about these Terms: hello@underflow.music.
terms.p_subject: Underflow is a music search and discovery tool. It aggregates publicly available metadata from third-party music platforms (Bandcamp, Juno Records, Beatport, Decks.de, Discogs) and presents it in one place. Underflow does not sell, host, or distribute music. The Service does not store, copy, or reproduce audio files. Preview playback streams directly from the respective platform's own servers using their public URLs; the Service does not cache or proxy those streams. Metadata — track titles, artist names, cover art, catalogue numbers — comes from publicly available search results and catalogues. Underflow is a metadata aggregator and a search interface, nothing more.
terms.p_beta: The Service is currently in open beta and is provided free of charge. Daily usage limits apply so the Service stays available to everyone; those limits may change. Features may be added, altered, or removed during the beta, and the Service may be unavailable at times. If paid plans are introduced later, accounts created during the beta keep their beta terms unless you choose otherwise, and you will be told before anything changes.
terms.p_accounts: You need an account to use the Service, and you must be at least 16 years old to create one. Provide accurate registration details and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. Tell us at hello@underflow.music if you believe your account has been accessed by someone else.
terms.p_rights: You agree to use the Service for lawful purposes only; not to attempt to circumvent usage limits or access controls; not to reverse-engineer the Service; not to resell or redistribute access to the Service; and to comply yourself with the terms of use of the third-party platforms whose listings you reach through the Service. Responsibility for complying with those platforms' rules rests with you.
terms.p_yourdata: Your library — tracks, tags, wishlists, buy list, and settings — is stored in a database file on your own device. It is yours. You can export it at any time, and it stays with you if you stop using the Service or if the Service ends.
terms.p_ip: The Service itself — its source code, design, name, and documentation — belongs to its developer. You get a limited, non-exclusive right to use the Service as it is intended to be used; this does not include copying, modifying, distributing, or building derivative works from it. Musical works whose metadata and previews appear in search results belong to their respective rights holders — authors, performers, labels, and publishers. Underflow claims no rights over them.
terms.p_liability: The Service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for: the availability of third-party platforms; the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of results drawn from them; the content or quality of previews streamed from their servers; purchasing decisions you make on those platforms; your breach of a third-party platform's terms; or loss caused by events beyond our reasonable control. Because the Service is free, our aggregate liability to you is limited to the amount you have paid for it, which is zero. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.
terms.p_termination: You may stop using the Service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaches these Terms, and will tell you by email when we do, except where that is not possible. Whatever happens to your account, your local collection stays on your device.

Continuing to use the Service after that means you accept the new version; if you do not, stop using the Service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p_operator: Underflow is an independent project. The developer of Underflow is the controller of the personal data described below. For any question about your data, or to exercise any of the rights in section 8, write to hello@underflow.music — that address reaches a person, not a queue.
privacy.p_short: We collect as little as we can: an email address so you can have an account, and the technical minimum needed to keep the Service running and secure. Your music collection never leaves your computer. We do not sell your data, we do not advertise to you, and we do not profile you.
privacy.p_collected: Email address — to create your account, sign you in, and send service notices. Password — stored only as a cryptographic hash, never in readable form. IP address and a device identifier — to keep accounts secure, recognise your devices, and detect abuse. Usage data — search counts and feature usage, used to keep the Service within its capacity and to understand what to improve. We do not ask for your real name, address, or payment details, because the Service is free and does not need them.
privacy.p_local: Your library — tracks, tags, wishlists, buy list, and settings — lives in a database file on your own computer. It is not uploaded to our servers and is not covered by this Policy, because we never see it. The application also uses local storage on your device for settings and your sign-in session.
privacy.p_legal_basis: We process your data to perform the agreement between us — you cannot have an account without an email address. We rely on our legitimate interest in keeping the Service secure and available for the technical data in section 3. Where we ask for your consent, you can withdraw it at any time, and withdrawing it does not affect processing that already happened.
privacy.p_third: Our hosting and database provider, which stores the data on our behalf and may not use it for anything else. Our email provider, to deliver account and verification messages. Google, only if you choose to sign in with Google, and then only your email address is exchanged. Website analytics are handled by Plausible, which uses no cookies and collects no personal data. That is the whole list. We do not sell or rent your data to anyone, and we share it with authorities only where the law genuinely requires it.
privacy.p_location: Our server infrastructure runs in Amsterdam, in the European Union. If you sign in with Google, that exchange involves Google's own infrastructure, which may be outside the EU, under the safeguards Google applies to it.
privacy.p_rights_user: You can ask us what data we hold about you and get a copy of it; have it corrected if it is wrong; have it deleted; object to or restrict how we use it; and take it elsewhere in a portable form. Write to hello@underflow.music and we will answer within 30 days. If you are unhappy with how we handled it, you can complain to the data protection authority where you live.
privacy.p_security: All traffic runs over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS). Passwords are hashed with a modern algorithm and are never stored or logged in readable form. Access to production systems is restricted and authenticated, sign-in supports a second factor by email, and you can review and revoke your registered devices and sessions from inside the application.
privacy.p_retention: We keep your account data for as long as your account exists. Delete your account and we erase the associated personal data within 30 days. Technical logs used for security are kept for a short period and then discarded.
privacy.p_children: The Service is not intended for anyone under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has created an account, tell us and we will remove it.
privacy.p_changes: If this Policy changes, the current version is always published at underflow.music/privacy.html, and we will tell you by email before any material change takes effect.
